patched: Intro Next/Back/Skip no longer sit on top of Nathan's lines, and Next is not an empty pill.
Clicking Nib's talk box advances the line (the parchment was eating the click).
Choice buttons sit inside the talk bar instead of on the frame.
Golem and Wizard inspect never show the roster note "plain ATK/HP Owner", including on Shift.
Adventure draft now has a Take it button next to Leave it.
Feedback pill hides during the opening will cutscene so Click to continue is readable.
F2's tier-list button is wider so the label is not three clipped lines.
Tutorial empty corridors show a faint plus so the wheel reads as eight seats.
Heart row sits above the wheel so all six hearts stay visible.
Combat log starts empty each fight and stays closed during the tutorial.
Opening Adventure mill does not grant two copies of the same starter item.
Middle Progress Challenge starts with the eight unlocked items already in the bag.
Challenge deck peek shows the next monster's name on a labeled bar under the sprite.
Hovering Helmet or Knucklers shows the formula. Tutorial inspects them when Nib points at them.
Six-monster wheels hide the call name unless you hover or face that slice.
